remarks: Enjoy downtown living at its best in this luxury, 2BR/2BA residence at the prestigious Classic Condominium in the heart of Stamford. Upscale high-rise just steps to restaurants, shopping, theater, concerts, and movies. The flexible layout offers extra space ideal for a den, home office, or dining area, while walls of windows provide panoramic skyline views. Move-in ready with custom built-ins in the living room and primary bedroom, engineered hardwood flooring throughout, custom window treatments in both bedrooms, and elegant ceiling moldings. The primary suite features a custom walk-in California Closet and a marble bath with jetted tub and glass enclosure. This unit also features large capacity in-unit laundry and heat included with the building. Amenities include a heated indoor pool, fitness center, newly updated common areas, private dog park, party room, secured garage, and 24-hour concierge!
